prompts.album: Create a transparent sprite atlas of 24 SEEYA fan-game album keepsake badges in an EXACT 6 columns by 4 rows grid. Every item fits fully inside its equal 256x256 cell with generous transparent margins. Crisp chunky pixel art, flat limited colors, no shadows/background, no generic trophies/instruments/crowns. Reference 1 defines pixel badge style; references 2-5 are real SEEYA fandom keepsakes: pink globe lightstick, fan standing calendar, slogan and acrylic ticket. These are original fan-game reinterpretations, not claims of real released merchandise. Eight sets of three in row-major order: 1-3 The First Mind white/red album-themed keepsakes: white jewel CD case with red SEEYA mark; ivory three-singer photocard sleeve; red/white ringbound mini scrapbook. 4-6 Lovely Sweet Heart blue/pink keepsakes: sky-blue pink-heart CD case; pink ribbon photocard fan; heart-shaped acrylic charm with three tiny white silhouettes. 7-9 California Dream lime-green keepsakes: lime CD package; green travel postcard with tiny red car; transparent green luggage-tag keyring with SEEYA mark. 10-12 Brilliant Change purple/lime/red keepsakes: purple retro album package; red mini stage-costume acrylic charm; lime folded slogan. 13-15 Rebloom black/silver keepsakes: black album with silver floral mark; silver-edged trio photocard; black concert ticket-holder charm. 16-18 See You Again caramel/cream keepsakes: cream orange-label album CD case; café trio polaroid; cream knit-texture fan pouch with tiny orange SEEYA label. 19-21 Still Here dark blue keepsakes: navy album sleeve with three small light dots; navy fan slogan with pink lettering SEEYA; small blue-edged photo frame with three standing singers. 22-24 First Again cream/blue 20th keepsakes: ivory album with blue ribbon; pink globe official SEEYA lightstick alongside small album; cream standing spiral calendar with pink SEEYA mark. Each trio must have clearly different silhouette and props, no repeated identical badges. No detailed Korean text, at most small SEEYA marks. Output 1536x1024 transparent.
